insight: Bootstrapped to profitability and once rejected by Y Combinator before Sequoia led a $35M Series A in 2022.
name: VEED.IO
tagline: Browser-based AI video editor with subtitles, dubbing, and avatars.
description: An all-in-one online video creation platform: a real timeline editor paired with AI tools for auto-subtitles, translation and dubbing, text-to-speech, AI avatars, background and noise removal, eye-contact correction, and text-to-video generation. Runs entirely in the browser, aimed at marketers, creators, and teams making social and brand video.

modelSupport.notes: Bundles multiple generative models for video, voice, and avatars.

edge: An all-in-one browser editor that pairs a real timeline with AI subtitles, dubbing, avatars, and generation — no install, unlike desktop NLEs.
pros: Full editor plus AI tools in the browser
cons: Free tier watermarks and caps exports
Less control than pro desktop NLEs
Heavy projects can feel sluggish in-browser

references.title: Veed, an online video editing platform, picks up $35M from Sequoia
